name: figures/ai_arch_v3
prompt: Academic architecture diagram, iteration 3. Clean CVPR style: pure white background, flat vector, rounded rectangles, Arial sans-serif labels, thick dark-gray SINGLE-HEADED arrows with large filled arrowheads, no double-headed arrows, no glow, no 3D, no watermark. TWO horizontal rows. TOP ROW (gray group 'Frozen LLM Backbone'), left to right: box 'x_t', circle-add symbol '(+)' labeled 'query add', box 'Attention', circle-add symbol '(+)' labeled 'output add', box 'y_t'. Horizontal single-headed arrows: x_t to query-add, query-add to Attention, Attention to output-add, output-add to y_t. BOTTOM ROW (lavender group 'delta-mem'), left to right: blue box 'Memory Projections q,k,v', orange box 'Gated Delta Write', purple box 'Online State S' drawn as an 8x8 grid, light-purple box 'Read r=Sq', green box 'Steering dq,do'. Horizontal single-headed arrows along the row: Projections to Write label 'k,v'; Write to State label 'update S'; State to Read label 'read'; Read to Steering label 'r'. VERTICAL single-headed arrows only these three: (1) from box 'x_t' in top row straight DOWN to 'Memory Projections' in bottom row, arrowhead at Projections, label 'hidden state'; (2) from 'Steering dq,do' straight UP to the 'query add' circle, arrowhead at the circle, label '+ dq'; (3) from 'Steering dq,do' UP to the 'output add' circle, arrowhead at the circle, label '+ do'. No other arrows. No arrow between State and Steering. Balanced whitespace, print-friendly.

name: figures/ai_granularity_v3
prompt: Academic diagram, iteration 3. Clean CVPR style, white background, three horizontal panels separated by thin vertical gray lines, flat vector squares, thick dark SINGLE-HEADED arrows, Arial labels WITHOUT any subscripts or parentheses, no glow, no watermark. Panel 1 title 'Token-State Write (TSW)': top row four blue squares labeled x, x, x, x; bottom row four purple squares labeled S, S, S, S; four vertical arrows each from one blue square down to the purple square directly below; three horizontal arrows chaining the purple squares left to right. Caption 'write at every token'. Panel 2 title 'Sequence-State Write (SSW)': top row blue squares grouped by dashed rounded rectangles into three groups of sizes two, one, three; the squares inside are labeled x; exactly three vertical arrows labeled 'mean', one from the middle of each group down to three purple squares labeled S, S, S; two horizontal arrows chaining them. Caption 'one write per message'. Panel 3 title 'Multi-State Write (MSW)': ONE blue square labeled x at top-left; BELOW it three purple squares stacked vertically labeled S, S, S; three HORIZONTAL parallel single-headed arrows from the blue square region: draw a vertical spine line down from the blue square, then three horizontal arrows from the spine into each purple square; to the right of each purple square a green square labeled r connected by a horizontal arrow; the three green squares each send one arrow into a single white box labeled 'concat' at right. Caption 'parallel sub-states reduce interference'. No arrows to empty space, no double-headed arrows.
